record.file_problem: Repository metadata, README, and only the first 400 of 526 file paths are provided; code and result-file contents are not available.
record.tranche_reason: The README documents a refusal-direction pipeline, and the file list contains run artifacts named for mean differences, ablation, activation addition, evaluations, and baselines. Their results are not included in the supplied text.
record.gate_note: The README gives setup and execution commands but no reported outcomes. The listed run artifacts suggest the refusal-direction interventions were run; filenames alone do not establish their effects. The README's layer and steering-coefficient search is setup, not a reported result.
record.test_reason: The repository is for rare-event estimation (Monte Carlo and SMC estimates of harmful or persona outputs). It runs the original refusal-direction pipeline as a prerequisite step: the README says users must compute the refusal direction even to use persona vectors. The README reports no outcomes of ablation or activation addition on refusal. Run artifacts named for ablation and actadd evaluations exist, but their contents are not supplied, so no result on any version can be read. The record's 'tests/T1' depends only on filenames; this fits T4 (uses the finding as a tool) unless the result files show otherwise.
record.authors_conclusion: Correct: the README states no conclusion about the refusal direction. It presents the direction only as a required step for steering and rare-event estimation.
record.recipe_differences: The repository names mean-difference, ablation, and activation-addition artifacts, but the method and measures cannot be verified from filenames. It is a tool/research repository; the README does not state that it is a replication.
record.method_sensitivity: The README says the persona-vector pipeline searches over steering coefficients and layers; it gives no outcome showing how these choices affect refusal.
record.problems: Only README instructions and filenames are available. The results and evaluation contents are not supplied, so no outcome or uncertainty can be extracted.
record.rows_left_out: No rows: the README reports no results, and the file list provides artifact names but not their values or contents.

untested.parts: No refusal rates under ablation or addition, and no capability or loss results, are stated. Only file names such as jailbreakbench_ablation_evaluations.json appear.
No weight edit or abliterated-model result.
There is a run on Llama-3-8B-Instruct-RR (a circuit-breaker-trained model) and jailbreak data, but no result links attacks or robustness to the direction.
No comparison of single versus multiple directions.
Many model families were run, but no transfer result is stated.
No variation in training method or timing is reported.

missing.what: Per-model refusal and safety scores for baseline, direction ablation and activation addition on JailbreakBench and harmless sets, plus CE-loss evaluations. These could bear on V1 across about 14 instruct models, including Olmo-3, Qwen3, gemma-2 and Llama-3.2. The Llama-3-8B-Instruct-RR run may bear on V3 or V7.

record.verdict_notes: Read status is partial: only the README and 400 of 526 file paths were available. The relation was changed from tests/T1 to uses_without_test/T4 because the repository's purpose is rare-event estimation and no refusal-direction results are reported. Reconsider if the evaluation JSONs are obtained: they would then be an unreported multi-model replication of V1 (T1/T3).
